_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fluid#1, and a FALSIFICATION of every identifier in it. The entry puts the stabilisation knobs in 'FLUID DYNAMIC/STABILIZATION' and says the tau parameter is raised through 'TAU_TYPE / TAU_DEF'; it also spells the grad-div flag 'GRAD-DIV'. Measured on a self-contained 2-D fluid deck at DYNVISCOSITY 1e-3: 'FLUID DYNAMIC/STABILIZATION' is rejected from core/io/src/4C_io_input_file.cpp as not a valid section name, and TAU_TYPE, TAU_DEF and the hyphenated GRAD-DIV are each left unmatched by core/io/src/4C_io_input_spec_builders.cpp with 'Could not match this input' and echoed back under 'The following data remains unused:'. The RULE survives: the residual-based default gives velx 9.97552834581135306e-01 at node 25, STABTYPE 'no_stabilization' gives 9.56217811466662959e-01, and the real key DEFINITION_TAU 'Taylor_Hughes_Zarins' inside 'FLUID DYNAMIC/RESIDUAL-BASED STABILIZATION' is accepted and gives 1.00063920214455182e+00 — so the tau definition is the knob, under a different name. The Signal is also unobservable: neither the default nor the unstabilised run reports any integrated kinetic energy (KINETIC_ENERGY_REPORTED=0). Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Section 'FLUID DYNAMIC/STABILIZATION' is not a valid section name.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the section-name arm: use the real section. Its 'not a valid section name' line disappears and the fixture must go red — that line is the falsification of the path the entry gives.
remove the pathology from the TAU_TYPE arm: write the real key instead. The deck is accepted, TAU_TYPE_UNUSED stops being 2 and the fixture must go red.

remove the numeric contrast: run the 'no_stabilization' arm with the default stabilisation. NOSTAB_VELX becomes the default value, STABILIZATION_CHANGES_THE_ANSWER flips to no and the fixture must go red — that comparison is the half of the entry that survives.
remove the hyphenated-flag arm's pathology: spell GRAD_DIV correctly. It is accepted, HYPHENATED_GRAD_DIV_UNUSED stops being 2 and the fixture must go red.
